item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00468","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C13","C02","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C13","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C13 is a highly persuasive drafting parent: it concerns the immediately preceding United States World Trade Fair at the same New York venue and uses nearly the same three-recital structure and operative invitation, with dates, annual designation, and minor descriptions updated for the 1958 fair. C02 and C16 use closely parallel congressionally authorized exposition-invitation machinery, but neither matches the child's event and language as specifically as C13.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas the Second Annual United States World Trade Fair is to be held at New York, New York, from May 7 to May 17, 1958, inclusive, for the purposes of exhibiting and promoting the sale of foreign and domestic products to the American trade and to the public","parent_excerpt":"Whereas the United States World Trade Fair is to be held at New York, New York, from April 14 to April 27, 1957, inclusive, for the purposes of exhibition, promotion, and sale of foreign products and services to the American trade and to the public","explanation":"The opening recital preserves the same event, location, date-slot structure, and statement of commercial purposes while updating the annual iteration and details."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas the Congress, other manner as he may deem proper, to invite the States of the Union and foreign countries to participate","explanation":"This is substantially identical authorization language performing the same role in the same recital position."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby invite the States of the Union and foreign countries to participate in the Second Annual United States World Trade Fair to be held in
